blurb: Fresno Flats is located in Oakhurst, California just 20 minutes south of Yosemite National Park. This park and museum uniquely recapture life in California’s “wild west” in the late 1800s, which includes several pioneer homes, two one-room schoolhouses, two jails, a blacksmith shop, a print shop, gift shop, wagon display, and a portion of the historic lumber flume.
